recipes.title: Tomato Scrambled Eggs
recipes.blurb: The five-minute comfort plate: silky egg, jammy tomato, a pinch of sugar.

steps.n: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt until the yolks disappear.
Cut the tomato into thick wedges so they hold their shape.
Pour the egg into hot oil, stir once, and pull it out while still glossy.
Soften the tomato until it releases its juice, then fold the egg back in.
Scatter scallion over the top and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal Bowl
recipes.blurb: Oats simmered in broth with a jammy egg — breakfast that eats like dinner.

steps.n: Simmer the oats in broth until creamy, stirring now and then.
Wilt the spinach into the pot in the last minute.
Poach the egg until the white is set and the yolk still runs.
Slide the egg on top, finish with cheese and scallion.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.blurb: Three ingredients, one blender, a stack that tastes like a treat.

steps.n: Blend everything into a pourable batter and let it rest 5 minutes.
Cook small rounds until bubbles hold on the surface, then flip.
Stack them up and drizzle with honey.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.blurb: Eggs poached in a smoky pepper-tomato sauce, eaten straight out of the pan.

steps.n: Slice the onion and pepper into thin strips.
Sweat them slowly until soft and sweet.
Add tomato and spices, simmer down to a thick sauce.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until the whites set.
Shower with parsley and tear pita to scoop.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado Toast
recipes.blurb: Crisp toast, cool avocado, lemon and chilli to wake it all up.

steps.n: Toast the bread dry until it crackles.
Mash the avocado with lemon and salt, keeping it chunky.
Pile it on the toast and finish with chilli flakes.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Noodles
recipes.blurb: Pantry-only noodles that taste like you meant it.

steps.n: Boil the noodles one minute short of the packet time.
Mince the garlic finely.
Sizzle garlic in butter until fragrant but never brown.
Toss the noodles through with a splash of the cooking water.
Finish with cheese and scallion.

recipes.title: Leftover Egg Fried Rice
recipes.blurb: Cold rice, hot wok, whatever vegetables are hiding in the drawer.

steps.n: Dice the vegetables small so they cook in seconds.
Scramble the egg hard and fast, then set it aside.
Fry the rice until every grain is separate and slightly toasted.
Return the egg, season, and toss once more.

recipes.title: Ten-Minute Tomato Pasta
recipes.blurb: Garlic, tomato, olive oil — the whole point of keeping pasta in the house.

steps.n: Salt the water heavily and boil the pasta al dente.
Slice the garlic thin.
Cook the tomato down until it collapses into a sauce.
Finish the pasta in the sauce with a ladle of pasta water.
Grate over plenty of parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.blurb: A full dinner in one wok, built on yesterday's rice.

steps.n: Dice the chicken into bite-sized cubes.
Toss with soy sauce and a spoon of cornstarch while you prep.
Sear the chicken until golden, then move it to the side.
Scramble the egg in the same wok.
Add the rice and vegetables, frying until steaming hot.
Scatter scallion and serve.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu
recipes.blurb: Silken tofu in a numbing, glossy chilli sauce. Rice is not optional.

steps.n: Cut the tofu into 2cm cubes and let it drain.
Fry the mince until the fat renders and the edges crisp.
Add the aromatics and chilli until the oil turns red.
Slide in the tofu and simmer gently so it stays whole.
Thicken with a cornstarch slurry until the sauce clings.
Finish with scallion and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Ginger Chicken Stir Fry
recipes.blurb: Fast, bright, and endlessly adaptable to whatever vegetable you have.

steps.n: Slice the chicken thinly across the grain.
Mince the ginger and garlic.
Sear the chicken in a screaming-hot wok until just cooked.
Add the vegetables and aromatics, keeping everything moving.
Splash in the sauce and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.blurb: Velveted beef, crisp broccoli, a sauce that coats every piece.

steps.n: Marinate the beef with soy and cornstarch so it stays tender.
Blanch the broccoli for a minute, then shock it cold.
Sear the beef in one layer and pull it out early.
Fry the broccoli with the aromatics.
Return the beef, add the sauce, and reduce until glossy.

recipes.title: Weeknight Chicken Curry
recipes.blurb: One pot, warm spices, coconut milk doing the heavy lifting.

steps.n: Dice the onion and tomato.
Cook the onion base until deep golden — this is the whole flavour.
Toast the spices in the oil for a minute.
Brown the chicken pieces all over.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Finish with fresh coriander.

recipes.title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
recipes.blurb: A pantry curry that costs almost nothing and tastes like a lot.

steps.n: Dice the onion fine.
Soften the aromatics without colouring them too hard.
Add the spices and tomato and cook to a paste.
Tip in the chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer until thick.
Wilt in the spinach at the end.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken and Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Everything on one tray, into the oven, out again golden.

steps.n: Cut the potatoes into wedges so they crisp on every side.
Toss with oil, salt, and paprika.
Roast skin-side up until the skin blisters and the potatoes are crusty.
Squeeze lemon over everything before serving.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Wings
recipes.blurb: Shatteringly crisp with a spoon of oil and no deep-frying anxiety.

steps.n: Rub the wings with spices and let them sit while the fryer heats.
Air fry in a single layer, shaking the basket halfway.
Toss the hot wings in the glaze so it sets on contact.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Tofu
recipes.blurb: Cornstarch, hot air, and suddenly tofu is the best thing on the plate.

steps.n: Press the tofu dry and cube it.
Toss in soy sauce, then dust with cornstarch until powdery.
Air fry until the corners are deep gold and crunchy.
Scatter scallion and chilli over the top.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Chicken Rice
recipes.blurb: Chicken, rice, and aromatics go in; dinner comes out. No stirring.

steps.n: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear.
Slice the ginger and mushrooms thin.
Marinate the chicken in soy and sesame oil.
Lay the chicken over the rice and run a normal cook cycle.
Fluff, top with scallion, and let it steam 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Tomato Rice
recipes.blurb: One whole tomato sits on the rice and collapses into a sauce.

steps.n: Rinse the rice and add water as usual.
Sit a whole tomato in the middle, scatter sausage and corn around it.
Run a normal cook cycle and leave it to steam.
Burst the tomato and stir everything together with butter.

recipes.title: Soy Fried Rice Noodles
recipes.blurb: Smoky wok noodles with bean sprouts and a two-sauce glaze.

steps.n: Soften the noodles in hot water, then drain hard.
Flash the beef in the hot wok and remove.
Fry the noodles undisturbed to get some char, then toss.
Add the sauces and sprouts, toss twice, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon
recipes.blurb: Crisp-skinned salmon lacquered in a three-ingredient glaze.

steps.n: Lay the salmon skin-down in a dry hot pan and leave it alone.
Stir the glaze together while it cooks.
Pour in the glaze and spoon it over until sticky.
Serve over rice with scallion.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.blurb: Eight minutes, one pan, an unreasonable amount of garlic.

steps.n: Mince a small mountain of garlic.
Warm the garlic in butter until it just turns blonde.
Add the shrimp and cook until they curl and turn opaque.
Lemon, parsley, bread for the pan sauce.

recipes.title: Crispy Fish Tacos
recipes.blurb: Spiced white fish, cool slaw, warm tortilla, lime over everything.

steps.n: Shred the cabbage as fine as you can.
Dress the slaw with lime and mayo, and let it sit.
Coat the fish in seasoned flour.
Fry until the crust is golden and the fish flakes.
Warm the tortillas in the dry pan until they puff.
Build: tortilla, slaw, fish, avocado, more lime.

recipes.title: Skillet Beef Tacos
recipes.blurb: Cumin-heavy mince you can have on the table in twenty minutes.

steps.n: Dice the onion and tomato.
Brown the mince hard with the onion, breaking it up.
Add the spices and a splash of water to make it saucy.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill and top with cheese, lettuce, and lime.

recipes.title: Red Braised Pork Belly
recipes.blurb: A slow Sunday braise that turns sticky, dark, and impossibly tender.

steps.n: Cut the belly into large even cubes.
Blanch to remove the scum, then rinse.
Caramelise sugar in the pot and roll the pork through it.
Add aromatics and just enough water; braise low until a chopstick slides in.
Uncover and boil the sauce down to a lacquer.

recipes.title: Whole Roast Chicken
recipes.blurb: Salt it, roast it hot, rest it. The rest is just confidence.

steps.n: Pat the bird bone dry and salt it all over.
Mash butter with herbs and garlic.
Push the butter under the skin and stuff the cavity with lemon.
Roast on a bed of vegetables until the juices run clear.
Rest for 15 minutes before carving. Do not skip this.

recipes.title: Garlic Sauce Eggplant
recipes.blurb: Collapsing eggplant in a sweet-sour-savoury sauce. Rice-destroyer.

steps.n: Cut the eggplant into batons and salt them for 10 minutes.
Fry until the flesh turns creamy and the edges brown.
Push the eggplant aside and bloom the garlic and chilli.
Add the sauce and cook until it coats every piece.
Finish with scallion.

recipes.title: Potato and Pea Curry
recipes.blurb: Cheap, filling, and better the next day.

steps.n: Cut the potato into even chunks and dice the onion.
Fry the base until golden.
Add the spices and tomato and cook to a paste.
Add potato, peas, and water; simmer until the potato yields.
Coriander over the top, naan on the side.

recipes.title: Bacon Carbonara
recipes.blurb: Egg, cheese, pork fat, pepper. Nothing else — especially not cream.

steps.n: Boil the pasta in well-salted water.
Render the bacon slowly until crisp; keep the fat.
Whisk the eggs with cheese and a lot of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss pasta with the egg mix and pasta water until creamy.

recipes.title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
recipes.blurb: A proper roux-based sauce in the time it takes to boil the macaroni.

steps.n: Boil the macaroni just under al dente.
Cook butter and flour together for two minutes.
Whisk in the milk slowly so it never lumps.
Off the heat, melt in the cheese and a spoon of mustard.
Fold the pasta through the sauce and serve at once.

recipes.title: Weeknight Bibimbap Bowl
recipes.blurb: Rice, whatever vegetables you have, a fried egg, and a spoon of chilli.

steps.n: Cut the carrot into matchsticks.
Blanch the greens and squeeze them dry.
Season each vegetable separately with sesame oil and garlic.
Quickly fry the carrot and mushroom.
Fry an egg with a crisp edge and runny yolk.
Arrange everything over rice in neat piles and add chilli paste.

recipes.title: Tamarind-Style Pad Thai Noodles
recipes.blurb: Sweet, sour, salty noodles with egg and a squeeze of lime.

steps.n: Soak the noodles until bendy but not soft.
Stir the sauce: equal parts salty, sour, sweet.
Flash the shrimp and set aside.
Scramble the egg on one side of the wok.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss until the pan is dry.
Chilli, lime, and crushed nuts at the table.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.blurb: Rich mince under a mash lid, browned until the peaks catch.

steps.n: Boil the potatoes until a knife slides through.
Dice the onion and carrot small.
Brown the mince with the vegetables.
Add stock and tomato paste and simmer to a thick gravy.
Mash the potato with plenty of butter and a splash of milk.
Spread the mash over the mince, fork the top, and bake until golden.

recipes.title: Skillet Margherita Flatbread
recipes.blurb: Blistered flatbread with tomato and mozzarella, no pizza oven required.

steps.n: Knead a simple dough and let it rise while you prep.
Roll it out thin enough to see the bench through it.
Top with crushed tomato, torn mozzarella, and garlic.
Start it in a hot dry skillet, then finish under the oven's top heat.
Basil and olive oil once it comes out.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese
recipes.blurb: A long-simmered meatless ragu that fools almost everybody.

steps.n: Dice the soffritto vegetables very fine.
Sweat them slowly for 15 minutes — do not rush this.
Fry the tomato paste until it darkens.
Add lentils, tomato, and stock; simmer until thick and glossy.
Cook the pasta and finish it in the sauce.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Steak
recipes.blurb: Hard sear, butter baste, rest. A pan sauce from what's left behind.

steps.n: Take the steak out early, pat it dry, and salt it hard.
Sear undisturbed until a deep crust forms, then flip.
Add butter, garlic, and herbs and baste for a minute.
Rest the steak on a board for as long as it cooked.
Deglaze the pan and reduce to a spoonable sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.blurb: The one you make when someone in the house is under the weather.

steps.n: Slice the vegetables into coins and half-moons.
Soften them in the bottom of the pot.
Add the chicken and stock and simmer gently.
Shred the chicken, return it, and cook the noodles in the broth.
Parsley and a lot of black pepper.

recipes.title: Tomato Egg Drop Soup
recipes.blurb: Ten minutes from cold pot to comforting bowl.

steps.n: Cut the tomato into wedges.
Boil the tomato until the skins loosen and the broth turns red.
Beat the egg until completely smooth.
Thicken slightly, then pour the egg in a thin stream while stirring one way.
Sesame oil and scallion off the heat.

recipes.title: Pantry Minestrone
recipes.blurb: Whatever vegetables are left, plus beans and a parmesan rind.

steps.n: Dice all the vegetables to roughly the same size.
Sweat the base until soft.
Add tomato, stock, and beans and simmer.
Add the pasta for the last ten minutes and wilt in the greens.
Parmesan and olive oil in the bowl.

recipes.title: Tofu Seaweed-Style Soup
recipes.blurb: Clear, savoury, and on the table before the rice finishes.

steps.n: Cut the tofu into small cubes.
Warm the broth with ginger and mushrooms — never let it boil hard.
Slip the tofu in and heat it through.
Scallion and a drop of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato Soup
recipes.blurb: Roast the tomatoes first and the soup makes itself.

steps.n: Halve the tomatoes and onion.
Roast until the edges char and the juices caramelise.
Blend everything with stock until velvety.
Stir in cream and basil, then taste for salt.

recipes.title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Boiled, squashed, roasted — maximum crunchy surface area.

steps.n: Boil small potatoes until completely tender.
Press each one flat with the base of a cup.
Douse with oil, rosemary, garlic, and salt.
Roast hard until the edges shatter.

recipes.title: Blistered Garlic Green Beans
recipes.blurb: High heat, no crowding, garlic at the very end.

steps.n: Snap the ends off the beans and dry them well.
Fry in a dry hot wok until they blister and wrinkle.
Add garlic and soy at the very end so nothing burns.

recipes.title: Charred Roasted Broccoli
recipes.blurb: The version that converts people who say they hate broccoli.

steps.n: Cut into florets with a flat side each.
Toss with oil, garlic, and salt.
Roast cut-side down until the edges blacken.
Lemon and parmesan straight out of the oven.

recipes.title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
recipes.blurb: Bruised cucumber soaks up dressing the way sliced never does.

steps.n: Smack the cucumbers with the flat of a knife, then tear into pieces.
Whisk the dressing with a lot of raw garlic.
Toss and let it sit ten minutes before eating.

recipes.title: Greek Village Salad
recipes.blurb: No lettuce. Just good tomato, cucumber, onion, and olive oil.

steps.n: Cut everything into generous chunks.
Slice the onion paper-thin and rinse it in cold water.
Dress with oil, oregano, and salt only.
Lay the cheese on top in one slab.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Fries
recipes.blurb: Soak, dry, one spoon of oil. Crisp outside, fluffy inside.

steps.n: Cut into even batons and soak them in cold water 15 minutes.
Dry completely, then toss with a single spoon of oil.
Air fry in one layer, shaking twice.

recipes.title: Steamed Eggplant with Garlic
recipes.blurb: Silky steamed eggplant torn by hand and drowned in garlic dressing.

steps.n: Split the eggplant lengthways.
Steam until a chopstick passes straight through.
Mix the dressing while it steams.
Tear into strips by hand and pour the dressing over.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Couscous
recipes.blurb: Boiling water, five minutes, and a side dish that saves dinner.

steps.n: Bring the water to a hard boil and season it.
Pour over the couscous, cover, and leave it alone for five minutes.
Fluff with a fork and fold through lemon, herbs, and oil.

recipes.title: Silky Hummus
recipes.blurb: Blend it longer than feels reasonable. That is the whole secret.

steps.n: Blend the chickpeas with lemon and garlic for a full four minutes.
Stream in oil and iced water until it turns pale and fluffy.
Swoosh into a bowl, dust with paprika, pool oil in the middle.

recipes.title: Proper Garlic Bread
recipes.blurb: Butter, garlic, parsley, and enough of all three.

steps.n: Mince the garlic and parsley into the butter.
Beat it into a soft spreadable paste.
Wrap in foil and bake, then open it for the last five minutes.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Popcorn Shrimp
recipes.blurb: Crunchy little bites without a pot of oil to deal with.

steps.n: Flour, egg, then seasoned crumb — press it on firmly.
Air fry until deeply golden, turning once.
Whisk a quick dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Scallion Pancakes
recipes.blurb: Layered, chewy, and worth the rolling and coiling.

steps.n: Knead a hot-water dough and rest it 30 minutes under a cloth.
Roll thin, brush with sesame oil, scatter scallion.
Roll it into a rope, coil it, then flatten again — that makes the layers.
Shallow fry until both sides are blistered and golden.
Serve with a sharp dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Five-Minute Mug Brownie
recipes.blurb: For when the craving is not negotiable.

steps.n: Stir the dry ingredients in the mug until no streaks remain.
Beat in melted butter and milk until smooth.
Push a few squares of chocolate into the middle.
Microwave 60–80 seconds; it should still wobble in the centre.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Banana Bread
recipes.blurb: The best possible fate for three sad bananas.

steps.n: Mash the bananas but leave some lumps.
Brown the butter, cool it, then whisk with sugar and eggs.
Fold in the dry ingredients — stop the moment it comes together.
Bake until a skewer comes out with a few damp crumbs.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Chocolate Cookies
recipes.blurb: Crisp edge, soft middle, salt on top.

steps.n: Cream the butter and sugars until pale and airy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Fold in the flour and chocolate, then chill the dough 30 minutes.
Bake until the edges set but the centres still look underdone.
Flaky salt while they are still hot.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.blurb: Warm coconut rice against cold ripe mango.

steps.n: Rinse and soak the sticky rice for at least an hour.
Steam until translucent and chewy.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt — never boil it.
Pour most of it over the hot rice and let it drink for 20 minutes.
Slice the mango and pour the reserved sauce over the plate.

recipes.title: Yogurt Berry Parfait
recipes.blurb: No cooking at all, and it still looks like you tried.

steps.n: Slice the strawberries and toss them with a little honey.
Toast the oats and nuts dry until they smell nutty.
Layer yogurt, fruit, and crunch in a glass, twice over.
Honey and a mint leaf on top.

recipes.title: Chocolate Affogato Cups
recipes.blurb: Two ingredients, thirty seconds, always a hit.

steps.n: Scoop the ice cream into cold cups.
Pour hot melted chocolate over so it seizes on contact.
Crushed almonds and cocoa to finish.

convertedRecipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon
convertedRecipes.description: Crisp-skinned salmon lacquered in a three-ingredient glaze.

steps.notes: Lay the salmon skin-down in a dry hot pan and leave it alone.
Stir the glaze together while it cooks.
Pour in the glaze and spoon it over until sticky.
Serve over rice with scallion.

convertedRecipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
convertedRecipes.description: Eight minutes, one pan, an unreasonable amount of garlic.

steps.notes: Mince a small mountain of garlic.
Warm the garlic in butter until it just turns blonde.
Add the shrimp and cook until they curl and turn opaque.
Lemon, parsley, bread for the pan sauce.

convertedRecipes.title: Crispy Fish Tacos
convertedRecipes.description: Spiced white fish, cool slaw, warm tortilla, lime over everything.

steps.notes: Shred the cabbage as fine as you can.
Dress the slaw with lime and mayo, and let it sit.
Coat the fish in seasoned flour.
Fry until the crust is golden and the fish flakes.
Warm the tortillas in the dry pan until they puff.
Build: tortilla, slaw, fish, avocado, more lime.

convertedRecipes.title: Skillet Beef Tacos
convertedRecipes.description: Cumin-heavy mince you can have on the table in twenty minutes.

steps.notes: Dice the onion and tomato.
Brown the mince hard with the onion, breaking it up.
Add the spices and a splash of water to make it saucy.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill and top with cheese, lettuce, and lime.

convertedRecipes.title: Red Braised Pork Belly
convertedRecipes.description: A slow Sunday braise that turns sticky, dark, and impossibly tender.

steps.notes: Cut the belly into large even cubes.
Blanch to remove the scum, then rinse.
Caramelise sugar in the pot and roll the pork through it.
Add aromatics and just enough water; braise low until a chopstick slides in.
Uncover and boil the sauce down to a lacquer.

convertedRecipes.title: Whole Roast Chicken
convertedRecipes.description: Salt it, roast it hot, rest it. The rest is just confidence.

steps.notes: Pat the bird bone dry and salt it all over.
Mash butter with herbs and garlic.
Push the butter under the skin and stuff the cavity with lemon.
Roast on a bed of vegetables until the juices run clear.
Rest for 15 minutes before carving. Do not skip this.

convertedRecipes.title: Garlic Sauce Eggplant
convertedRecipes.description: Collapsing eggplant in a sweet-sour-savoury sauce. Rice-destroyer.

steps.notes: Cut the eggplant into batons and salt them for 10 minutes.
Fry until the flesh turns creamy and the edges brown.
Push the eggplant aside and bloom the garlic and chilli.
Add the sauce and cook until it coats every piece.
Finish with scallion.

convertedRecipes.title: Potato and Pea Curry
convertedRecipes.description: Cheap, filling, and better the next day.

steps.notes: Cut the potato into even chunks and dice the onion.
Fry the base until golden.
Add the spices and tomato and cook to a paste.
Add potato, peas, and water; simmer until the potato yields.
Coriander over the top, naan on the side.

convertedRecipes.title: Bacon Carbonara
convertedRecipes.description: Egg, cheese, pork fat, pepper. Nothing else — especially not cream.

steps.notes: Boil the pasta in well-salted water.
Render the bacon slowly until crisp; keep the fat.
Whisk the eggs with cheese and a lot of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss pasta with the egg mix and pasta water until creamy.

convertedRecipes.title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
convertedRecipes.description: A proper roux-based sauce in the time it takes to boil the macaroni.

steps.notes: Boil the macaroni just under al dente.
Cook butter and flour together for two minutes.
Whisk in the milk slowly so it never lumps.
Off the heat, melt in the cheese and a spoon of mustard.
Fold the pasta through the sauce and serve at once.

convertedRecipes.title: Weeknight Bibimbap Bowl
convertedRecipes.description: Rice, whatever vegetables you have, a fried egg, and a spoon of chilli.

steps.notes: Cut the carrot into matchsticks.
Blanch the greens and squeeze them dry.
Season each vegetable separately with sesame oil and garlic.
Quickly fry the carrot and mushroom.
Fry an egg with a crisp edge and runny yolk.
Arrange everything over rice in neat piles and add chilli paste.

convertedRecipes.title: Tamarind-Style Pad Thai Noodles
convertedRecipes.description: Sweet, sour, salty noodles with egg and a squeeze of lime.

steps.notes: Soak the noodles until bendy but not soft.
Stir the sauce: equal parts salty, sour, sweet.
Flash the shrimp and set aside.
Scramble the egg on one side of the wok.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss until the pan is dry.
Chilli, lime, and crushed nuts at the table.

convertedRecipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
convertedRecipes.description: Rich mince under a mash lid, browned until the peaks catch.

steps.notes: Boil the potatoes until a knife slides through.
Dice the onion and carrot small.
Brown the mince with the vegetables.
Add stock and tomato paste and simmer to a thick gravy.
Mash the potato with plenty of butter and a splash of milk.
Spread the mash over the mince, fork the top, and bake until golden.

convertedRecipes.title: Skillet Margherita Flatbread
convertedRecipes.description: Blistered flatbread with tomato and mozzarella, no pizza oven required.

steps.notes: Knead a simple dough and let it rise while you prep.
Roll it out thin enough to see the bench through it.
Top with crushed tomato, torn mozzarella, and garlic.
Start it in a hot dry skillet, then finish under the oven's top heat.
Basil and olive oil once it comes out.

convertedRecipes.title: Lentil Bolognese
convertedRecipes.description: A long-simmered meatless ragu that fools almost everybody.

steps.notes: Dice the soffritto vegetables very fine.
Sweat them slowly for 15 minutes — do not rush this.
Fry the tomato paste until it darkens.
Add lentils, tomato, and stock; simmer until thick and glossy.
Cook the pasta and finish it in the sauce.

convertedRecipes.title: Pan-Seared Steak
convertedRecipes.description: Hard sear, butter baste, rest. A pan sauce from what's left behind.

steps.notes: Take the steak out early, pat it dry, and salt it hard.
Sear undisturbed until a deep crust forms, then flip.
Add butter, garlic, and herbs and baste for a minute.
Rest the steak on a board for as long as it cooked.
Deglaze the pan and reduce to a spoonable sauce.

convertedRecipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
convertedRecipes.description: The one you make when someone in the house is under the weather.

steps.notes: Slice the vegetables into coins and half-moons.
Soften them in the bottom of the pot.
Add the chicken and stock and simmer gently.
Shred the chicken, return it, and cook the noodles in the broth.
Parsley and a lot of black pepper.

convertedRecipes.title: Tomato Egg Drop Soup
convertedRecipes.description: Ten minutes from cold pot to comforting bowl.

steps.notes: Cut the tomato into wedges.
Boil the tomato until the skins loosen and the broth turns red.
Beat the egg until completely smooth.
Thicken slightly, then pour the egg in a thin stream while stirring one way.
Sesame oil and scallion off the heat.

convertedRecipes.title: Pantry Minestrone
convertedRecipes.description: Whatever vegetables are left, plus beans and a parmesan rind.

steps.notes: Dice all the vegetables to roughly the same size.
Sweat the base until soft.
Add tomato, stock, and beans and simmer.
Add the pasta for the last ten minutes and wilt in the greens.
Parmesan and olive oil in the bowl.

convertedRecipes.title: Tofu Seaweed-Style Soup
convertedRecipes.description: Clear, savoury, and on the table before the rice finishes.

steps.notes: Cut the tofu into small cubes.
Warm the broth with ginger and mushrooms — never let it boil hard.
Slip the tofu in and heat it through.
Scallion and a drop of sesame oil.

convertedRecipes.title: Roasted Tomato Soup
convertedRecipes.description: Roast the tomatoes first and the soup makes itself.

steps.notes: Halve the tomatoes and onion.
Roast until the edges char and the juices caramelise.
Blend everything with stock until velvety.
Stir in cream and basil, then taste for salt.

convertedRecipes.title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
convertedRecipes.description: Boiled, squashed, roasted — maximum crunchy surface area.

steps.notes: Boil small potatoes until completely tender.
Press each one flat with the base of a cup.
Douse with oil, rosemary, garlic, and salt.
Roast hard until the edges shatter.

convertedRecipes.title: Blistered Garlic Green Beans
convertedRecipes.description: High heat, no crowding, garlic at the very end.

steps.notes: Snap the ends off the beans and dry them well.
Fry in a dry hot wok until they blister and wrinkle.
Add garlic and soy at the very end so nothing burns.

convertedRecipes.title: Charred Roasted Broccoli
convertedRecipes.description: The version that converts people who say they hate broccoli.

steps.notes: Cut into florets with a flat side each.
Toss with oil, garlic, and salt.
Roast cut-side down until the edges blacken.
Lemon and parmesan straight out of the oven.

convertedRecipes.title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
convertedRecipes.description: Bruised cucumber soaks up dressing the way sliced never does.

steps.notes: Smack the cucumbers with the flat of a knife, then tear into pieces.
Whisk the dressing with a lot of raw garlic.
Toss and let it sit ten minutes before eating.

convertedRecipes.title: Greek Village Salad
convertedRecipes.description: No lettuce. Just good tomato, cucumber, onion, and olive oil.

steps.notes: Cut everything into generous chunks.
Slice the onion paper-thin and rinse it in cold water.
Dress with oil, oregano, and salt only.
Lay the cheese on top in one slab.

convertedRecipes.title: Air Fryer Fries
convertedRecipes.description: Soak, dry, one spoon of oil. Crisp outside, fluffy inside.

steps.notes: Cut into even batons and soak them in cold water 15 minutes.
Dry completely, then toss with a single spoon of oil.
Air fry in one layer, shaking twice.

convertedRecipes.title: Steamed Eggplant with Garlic
convertedRecipes.description: Silky steamed eggplant torn by hand and drowned in garlic dressing.

steps.notes: Split the eggplant lengthways.
Steam until a chopstick passes straight through.
Mix the dressing while it steams.
Tear into strips by hand and pour the dressing over.

convertedRecipes.title: Lemon Herb Couscous
convertedRecipes.description: Boiling water, five minutes, and a side dish that saves dinner.

steps.notes: Bring the water to a hard boil and season it.
Pour over the couscous, cover, and leave it alone for five minutes.
Fluff with a fork and fold through lemon, herbs, and oil.

convertedRecipes.title: Silky Hummus
convertedRecipes.description: Blend it longer than feels reasonable. That is the whole secret.

steps.notes: Blend the chickpeas with lemon and garlic for a full four minutes.
Stream in oil and iced water until it turns pale and fluffy.
Swoosh into a bowl, dust with paprika, pool oil in the middle.

convertedRecipes.title: Proper Garlic Bread
convertedRecipes.description: Butter, garlic, parsley, and enough of all three.

steps.notes: Mince the garlic and parsley into the butter.
Beat it into a soft spreadable paste.
Wrap in foil and bake, then open it for the last five minutes.

convertedRecipes.title: Air Fryer Popcorn Shrimp
convertedRecipes.description: Crunchy little bites without a pot of oil to deal with.

steps.notes: Flour, egg, then seasoned crumb — press it on firmly.
Air fry until deeply golden, turning once.
Whisk a quick dipping sauce.

convertedRecipes.title: Scallion Pancakes
convertedRecipes.description: Layered, chewy, and worth the rolling and coiling.

steps.notes: Knead a hot-water dough and rest it 30 minutes under a cloth.
Roll thin, brush with sesame oil, scatter scallion.
Roll it into a rope, coil it, then flatten again — that makes the layers.
Shallow fry until both sides are blistered and golden.
Serve with a sharp dipping sauce.

convertedRecipes.title: Five-Minute Mug Brownie
convertedRecipes.description: For when the craving is not negotiable.

steps.notes: Stir the dry ingredients in the mug until no streaks remain.
Beat in melted butter and milk until smooth.
Push a few squares of chocolate into the middle.
Microwave 60–80 seconds; it should still wobble in the centre.

convertedRecipes.title: Brown Butter Banana Bread
convertedRecipes.description: The best possible fate for three sad bananas.

steps.notes: Mash the bananas but leave some lumps.
Brown the butter, cool it, then whisk with sugar and eggs.
Fold in the dry ingredients — stop the moment it comes together.
Bake until a skewer comes out with a few damp crumbs.

convertedRecipes.title: Brown Sugar Chocolate Cookies
convertedRecipes.description: Crisp edge, soft middle, salt on top.

steps.notes: Cream the butter and sugars until pale and airy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Fold in the flour and chocolate, then chill the dough 30 minutes.
Bake until the edges set but the centres still look underdone.
Flaky salt while they are still hot.

convertedRecipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
convertedRecipes.description: Warm coconut rice against cold ripe mango.

steps.notes: Rinse and soak the sticky rice for at least an hour.
Steam until translucent and chewy.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt — never boil it.
Pour most of it over the hot rice and let it drink for 20 minutes.
Slice the mango and pour the reserved sauce over the plate.

convertedRecipes.title: Yogurt Berry Parfait
convertedRecipes.description: No cooking at all, and it still looks like you tried.

steps.notes: Slice the strawberries and toss them with a little honey.
Toast the oats and nuts dry until they smell nutty.
Layer yogurt, fruit, and crunch in a glass, twice over.
Honey and a mint leaf on top.

convertedRecipes.title: Chocolate Affogato Cups
convertedRecipes.description: Two ingredients, thirty seconds, always a hit.

steps.notes: Scoop the ice cream into cold cups.
Pour hot melted chocolate over so it seizes on contact.
Crushed almonds and cocoa to finish.

cookMethods.label: Fried
cookMethods.description: Cooked in hot oil or fat
